messages.text: The east market opened at 09:00 UTC.
I counted 18 cedar bundles at the east stall.
The north stall has 7 iron bars.
Lio is checking the bridge inventory.
Two carts reached Pine Crossing.
The dye table is beside the fountain.
The copper order contains 12 crates.
I left a lantern at the west gate.
The stone counter closes at 11:30 UTC.
Sena collected 4 repair kits.
The south path is clear.
A bell rang near Cedar Hall.
The tool shelf holds 9 hammers.
Rin moved the seed sacks indoors.
The river dock has one empty berth.
I saw 6 clay jars by the kiln.
The orchard gate is unlocked.
Vale requested rope at the depot.
The meal cart serves until noon.
I found 3 blue ribbons.
The plaza clock is running.
Good morning everyone.
My tea is still warm.
That cloud looks like a boot.
